name: QG-I536: Acceptance emails show the Weekly frequency the broker accepted a Daily offer with
description:
Objective: Acceptance emails show the Weekly frequency the broker accepted a Daily offer with.
Preconditions: Kesef CRM QA at the configured origin; authorized test account; the run's shared or own regression application, or an existing application in the needed state discovered read-only.
Steps:
1. Follow the reproduction steps of QG-I536.
2. Evaluate the encoded checks in `test_acceptance_emails_show_the_accepted_weekly_frequency`.
3. Record any mismatch as a normal failure; do not skip, xfail or weaken the assertion.
Expected: 1. Acceptance emails show the Weekly frequency the broker accepted a Daily offer with.
2. The bug's expected result holds; no unintended record or state residue on shared applications.
